assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Focus Lab Productions homepage hero, wide cinematic website banner
Primary request: Create a believable high-end documentary photograph of an active Dallas–Fort Worth wedding reception celebration that communicates one coordinated event crew without depicting identifiable staff.
Scene/backdrop: Contemporary indoor reception venue, premium but approachable, guests gathered around a couple during an energetic entrance or dance-floor moment; tasteful DJ and architectural lighting atmosphere visible in the room.
Subject: Diverse adult couple and guests in candid motion and genuine interaction, realistic skin texture and anatomy.
Style/medium: Photorealistic editorial event photography, natural color, controlled highlights, 35mm documentary feel.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:10 landscape. Keep the left 35 percent visually calm and darker for white headline overlay. Place the main emotional interaction center-right; composition must also crop well to 4:5 around the couple and nearest guests.
Lighting/mood: Warm cinematic practicals, confident, alive, joyful, premium but not opulent; subtle amber/orange environmental echo only.
Constraints: No text, no watermark, no logos, no recognizable venue, no fake company branding, no unsafe effects, no posed catalog portrait, no impossible lighting rig, no orange color wash, no uncanny hands or faces.
